notes.title: Dedicated Server & 'Human vs Human only' Leaderboards released with latest patch
notes.content:
The latest patch for Booster Trooper contains the awaited dedicated server.
Here is the list of all changes since Build 160:

    * Added: Dedicated Servers
    * Added: new map - Molten Rock
    * Added: "Bots Free" leaderboards only for games human vs human with no bots
    * Fixed: infinite join sound in hardcore mode
    * Fixed: several achievement detections
    * Added: Hz setting for resolutions
    * Added: password protected hosts
    * Added: sfx for spawn protect duration
    * Fixed: added missing low-textures on scrapyard
    * Improved: if reload was interrupted by grenade usage or weaponchange it will restart
    * Improved: no shooting during respawn protection
    * Improved: gfx detail option now affects physics details as well
    * Fixed: duck down accuracy check

notes.title: Booster Trooper Now Available, 10% Off
notes.content:
Booster Trooper from DnS Development is now available on Steam and 10% off for the first week.

Booster Trooper is the future of multiplayer platform shooters. It provides tons of fun with its fast paced action and larger-than-life weapons. You can run or fly around the map, blasting your enemies to bits with bullets, rockets, grenades, magma and other weapons from your arsenal.

Whether you play it against the BOTs or a live player, Booster Trooper will constantly keep you on the edge! Rankings, co-operation, tactics and split second decisions will deliver hours and hours of online multiplayer entertainment!

Booster Trooper includes 260 Steam Achievements and takes advantage of Steam's Leaderboards and Stats.
